text:
maria: Hey team — thinking out loud about a lightweight SI 'Swift-Start' path we can pilot. Goal: let an SI go from zero to validated deployer in 2 weeks with modular micro-cert tracks and a short hands-on lab. :rocket:
aj: Nice. What's in a micro-cert track? exam? hands-on lab?
sophie: Prefer short measurable milestones (1 hr module + 30m quiz). Keeps momentum.
maria: Exactly — 4 tracks: infra prep, Redwood API basics, model routing+fallbacks, and cost ops. Each track = 45–75m content + 1 lab exercise.
devon: For labs we need hardware partner seats. I can arrange 10 voucher sessions with BroadPeak lab for Q2. Voucher codes will be single-use for 2-hour reserved slots.
aj: How do we validate the SI at the end? live demo or recorded checklist?
maria: Proposal: 15-min demo + automatic eval of lab outputs. Pass = micro-cert badge. 3 badges -> 'Swift-Start Certified' crown. No heavy proctoring.
sophie: Can we tie marketplace listing pre-reqs to the cert? e.g., must have one successful deploy in our staging marketplace to be eligible for co-marketing.
devon: Agree. I can add a checkbox in the partner portal for "staging deploy verified". Also need a short runbook for infra quota requests.
partners-bot: New doc created: https://docs.redwood.com/si-swift-start/draft — please add comments by EOD Friday.
aj: Thx @partners-bot — I'll drop in a minimal rubric for the demo and a sample grading sheet.
maria: Next steps: devon to secure lab vouchers, partners-doc owners to draft modules (outline by Wed), aj to create demo rubric. Pilot cohort target = 6 SIs in late May.
sophie: I'll coordinate comms and a one-pager for sales enablement. Draft coming tomorrow.
devon: Voucher sample code format: `RBW-VCHR-<4chars>` — will push to partner portal once approved.
aj: Any legal/compliance blockers for sandbox data?
maria: We'll use scrubbed datasets and ephemeral tenants. Legal already okay with that model but will sign off on final wording.
sophie: Brilliant — this feels actionable. :thumbsup:
maria: Cool — thanks everyone. Ping me if you want to join the pilot planning session on Thurs 10am.
